main.description: A proposal to play a game of Manalath. Written to the challenger's repo. The match starts once the opponent writes an top.manalath.accept referencing this record. Moves form a tree; a match is a labelled path through it, starting at `root` (or at the empty board when `root` is absent).

opponent.description: The player being challenged. Absent for an open challenge that anyone may accept.

firstMover.description: Who plays the first ply after `root`. `random` is resolved from the accept record's CID: if the last byte of the CID is even the challenger moves first, otherwise the opponent.

root.description: An existing top.manalath.move to continue from. Absent to start from the empty board.

arbiter.description: A game server both players agree to have run this match live. Not evidence in itself: an indexer treats the match as arbitrated only if this DID's repo holds a verdict record referencing this match by CID. Absent for self-reported games.
